The workbook generation failed because expected data cells in the 'Task' sheet were empty (None) instead of containing calculated values.
The verifier failed with AssertionError in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of the expected float values (e.g., H12 expected 612.5, H35 expected 4.499). This indicates the logic for populating these specific matrix ranges in the 'Task' worksheet is missing or failing to execute.
